name: Wait what
description: Two-panel Pepe: 'WAIT...' then 'WHAT?'. Double-take confusion when something does not add up.
whenToUse: When the message is confusing, sudden, contradictory, or you need them to repeat: wait, what, how, 'come again', plot twist. Good before asking a clarifying question. Comic disbelief, not insult.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it to mock a genuine question. Skip if you understood them. Not for greetings.
